import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.SymPowInvariantsLocalization

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry

universe u

variable {G A : Type u} [Group G] [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction G A]

-- probe: the action on the localization, as a MulSemiringAction
example (b : A) (hb : ∀ g : G, g • b = b) : True := by
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.awayMap (G := G) b hb
  trivial

-- probe: does `FixedPoints.subring` have a `MulSemiringAction`-free API for membership?
example (x : A) (h : ∀ g : G, g • x = x) : x ∈ FixedPoints.subring A G := h

-- probe: the invariant subring is a `CommRing`
example : CommRing (FixedPoints.subring A G) := inferInstance
